name: Odran Under-the-Stone
role: King of Deepmark, the dwarven kingdom in the deep stone under the Given Land, who holds that the deepest stone has never lied
appearance: Pale from never seeing the sun, beard to the floor and tucked into his belt, a crown of unpolished stone, and eyes that adjust to lamplight slowly.
voiceHints: Speaks in weights and measures. Says 'that is heavy' when he means 'that is true'.
wants: To go deeper than any dwarf has gone and hear what the stone says there.
fears: Something under Deepmark that is not stone.
knowledge: What the Masons above are building, by the weight on his ceiling
That the deepest shaft has started to ring

reactsToReputation.truthful: gives you a stone token that opens Deepmark's lower doors

questSeeds: The deepest shaft rings like a bell at the same hour every day
The Masons of Bedrock want a right-of-way down
title: King of Deepmark
